device: Microsoft SQ2 / Surface Pro X (Adreno 690 marketed name)
voltage_policy: Both the 590/661 and the opt-in 700 profile keep frequencies above 514 MHz on a firmware corner, not a guessed millivolt value. The default (661 MHz) uses the OEM TURBO_L1 corner 416. The 700/432 experiment raised both the clock and the corner; corner432 is not present in this platform's OEM opp table.

provenance.comparison: SC8280XP uses a separate A690.0 GPU/GMU path; its 655 MHz TURBO and 690 MHz TURBO_L1 entries are reference only. This is not proof that its lower-corner curve applies to SQ2.
provenance.target_661_mhz: Operator-specified SQ2 maximum. This frequency-to-corner pairing is experimental, not an extracted OEM voltage curve.

thermal_policy.module: qcom_tsens.ko for 6.3.8-sq2-android1, loaded before Android init
thermal_policy.cooling: Existing MSM devfreq cooling device, all states
thermal_policy.missing_sensor: Load-test script refuses to proceed; 661 MHz boot refuses a failed TSENS module load.

limits: Short functional/load tests do not establish OEM voltage equivalence, long-term stability or measured physical PLL frequency. a6xx_gmu_get_freq returns a cached requested frequency. See deployment-status.json for actual test/deployment results.
default_build: scripts/build-source-boot.py emits pinned661/416 by default (661/416 equals the pinned input, so no extra DT node is added) plus a separate514 rescue DTB; --gpu-profile experimental-700 re-enables the 700/432 transform. Disk build and deployment verify both hashes.
default_validation: 661/416 is the profile that ran on hardware with no observed GPU/GMU fault, hang or timeout in the checked logs. The 700/432 profile replaced it as default on 2026-10-30 with boot-only confirmation; the 2026-11-05 GMU watchdog lockups (HFI_H2F_MSG_GX_BW_PERF_VOTE timeout at perf index 10, the 700 MHz level) occurred while it was default. Reverting the default to 661/416 is a return to the validated configuration, not a proven root-cause fix: a soak at 661 is still required before the lockup can be called fixed.

experimental_700_record.validation_at_the_time: SQ2 Android boot confirmed at700/432; load and long-term stability never tested.
experimental_700_record.status: opt-in only; not part of any default build entry
